newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean President orders rise in defence budget.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean President orders rise in defence budget.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam ordered on Tuesday the defence budget to be increased by more than five percent in 1998, a presidential statement said.
The president's order came during a briefing on the 1998 national budget by finance minister Kang Kyong-shik who said the the government planned to increase the budget by about four percent.
"As tensions between North and South Korea continue, we need to modernise defence forces and encourage military morale more than any other time," Kim said.
He told Kang to raise the defence budget as much as the government can and said the increase should be more than five percent, higher than the estimated 1998 national budget rise of four percent.

A finance ministry official said defence was the largest single budgetary component. South Korea set aside 14 trillion won in the defence budget in 1997, accounting for about 20 percent of all expenditure.
